title: Ecology federal permits record: Mix Dock (Aquatics 137084)

licence.text: Use allowed with credit and a link; commercial and political use prohibited

rows.label: What the project is
rows.value: Remove existing dock and stairs. The existing facility includes stairs traversing a steep hillside for access to an 198 sf pier (10.5' x 18.83') supported by creosote piles, an 110 sf ramp (3.33' x 33'), and a 239 sf float (7' x 34.17') for a total area of 547 sf. The landward end of the float grounds out at lower tides. The hillside where the stairs are located would be remediated with appropriate vegetation for soil retention and bio-filtration of natural runoff.
